summary: Full frontend E2E validation of the new WhatsApp click-to-send notification flow, Bagikan ke WhatsApp share button, Honda CR-V Hybrid RS hero image, and multi-photo consignment upload. All 6 review-request test scenarios PASS. window.open URLs were captured on admin approve, admin reject, and the share button; every URL is a valid wa.me link with the expected owner phone (6282177826596) and expected message text (DISETUJUI / belum dapat kami setujui / Cek mobil ini).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/app/admin/page.tsx is now ~690 lines; still recommend splitting into Dashboard/Booking/Armada/TitipMobil subcomponents.
handleConsignmentAction() silently swallows fetch errors (empty catch); at minimum log or show a toast so admin knows the PATCH failed.

ownerStatusMessage() uses `${origin}/cars/${item.id}` for the approved link; verify /cars/[id] actually resolves for consignment IDs (route uses static+consignment IDs) — if it 404s for some IDs the owner will get a broken link.
waLink() uses phone `null` fallback to https://wa.me/ (no recipient) for the share button — intentional, but note WhatsApp on desktop may open the 'choose recipient' page. Acceptable.
Prototype storage remains a JSON file /app/data/consignments.json — not concurrency-safe.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only scope, backend flow already verified)

seed_data_creation: Created 3 new consignments during test: titip-muminhu6-ztlvh (Toyota QA Test 2022, jual, APPROVED via UI + wa.me captured), titip-muminlp9-qzjqm (Honda QA Reject 2021, jual, REJECTED via UI + wa.me captured), titip-mumij8wz-k2dxl (Toyota Avanza WATest 2022, jual, still PENDING). Multi-photo (2 photos) added via input-image-url + add-photo-url-button. All prior seed data preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App: Next.js only on port 3000 (frontend supervisor); backend supervisor entry stale. Data persists in /app/data/consignments.json. WhatsApp notifications are click-to-send: admin approve/reject calls PATCH /api/admin/consignments/[id] then window.open(wa.me/<normalized-phone>?text=<message>). To capture in tests, override window.open BEFORE clicking the approve/reject button on the same page context: `await page.evaluate("() => { window.__waUrls=[]; window.open=function(u){ window.__waUrls.push(u); return null; }; }")`. Testids confirmed: approve-<id>, reject-<id>, consign-status-<id>, admin-nav-consignments, consign-pending-badge, share-<carId>, hero-section, gallery-thumbs, gallery-thumb-<n>, gallery-counter, consign-submit-button, consign-success, input-image-url, add-photo-url-button. Owner phone normalization 081234567890 -> 6282177826596 verified. Approved status text = 'Disetujui', pending = 'Menunggu', rejected = 'Ditolak'.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 6 review request scenarios validated end-to-end via Playwright against http://localhost:3000.
